about: One colour per repo. Read it through lint/repo_colour.py (colour_for), never from a copy. A repo's own .claude/layout-extras.json key waiting-page-colour wins over this file. A repo that has its own brand colour keeps it, read from that repo; each source names where, and accents gives the same place as {file, token} for `repo_colour.py drift`, which reports a repo whose own value no longer matches this file. A repo with none gets a hue drawn from its name by the rule below, and the draw is stored here so a later repo never moves it. When a drawn repo gets its own colour, replace its entry and drop it from rule.drawn. Ruling: owner, 2026-10-26 20:37 CDT, roadmap step c105 (one colour wheel for every repo).
